title: Bounded constructible module complexes under weak Serre closure hypotheses
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $A$ a closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian category with additive tensor product, and $R$ a ring object of $\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. A module object is constructible if it has a finite locally closed constructible stratification [def-constructible-stratification] on each stratum of which it is pro-etale locally the cokernel of a map between finite-rank free modules over the restricted ring object. Assume this class of module objects is closed under kernels and cokernels of morphisms between its objects and under the middle term of a short exact sequence whose two outer terms belong to it. Then the full subcategory of the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] consisting of bounded complexes with constructible cohomology is triangulated. No noetherian hypothesis on $X$ is needed once these closure properties are assumed. The constructible class contains zero and is invariant under isomorphism by its definition.

source.place: Module docstring and DerivedCategory.homologyProperty_isTriangulated; specialization to ProEtale.IsConstructibleModuleObject and intersection with the canonical bounded t-structure property

proof.text: Transport the finite presentation isomorphism across the image of a module isomorphism under restriction to a stratum and then to each covering member. The stratification, the cover, the two finite ranks and the presenting map stay fixed. This proves invariance under isomorphism directly from the definition.

A zero module is the cokernel of the identity of the rank-zero free module, since the cokernel of an epimorphism is zero. Pullback of a zero module is zero because module restriction preserves finite colimits. Use the identity pro-etale cover and the single stratum X to deduce that zero is constructible.

Apply the general weak Serre class theorem DerivedCategory.homologyProperty_isTriangulated, recorded among the declarations of [prop-constructible-derived-subcategory], to the constructible-module property with the three assumed closure properties and the zero/isomorphism facts just proved. Intersect with the bounded part of the canonical t-structure. Mathlib supplies that the bounded part and the intersection of triangulated object properties are triangulated. The intersection is definitionally ProEtale.boundedConstructible R.
